title: refactor(plugin-dashboard,types): retire the unread widget `dataProvider` key (objectui#7353)
body:
Fixes #7353

Clause-②: yes — the ruling removes a declared member from a published prop type (`ObjectPivotTable` is exported from `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`) and from `ObjectDataTableSchema` on both faces.

This carries out ruling 5809008870 (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove, remove arm):

- The three `dataProvider: widgetData` writes are deleted.
- The two typed declarations are replaced by **retirement tombstones**, which refuse the key and point at `objectName`.
- No reader is added.

Round 2 applies contract review 5828182277 (FAIL at `35624634f`). That review found that the bare deletion left an authored `dataProvider` absorbed silently. It also found that the changeset described an unreleased `@object-ui/types` member as if it were published.

## What changed

| Site | Released 17.6.0 | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| `DashboardRenderer`, table arm (`object-data-table` node) | writes `objectName` and `dataProvider` | writes `objectName` only |
| `DashboardGridLayout`, table arm (`data-table` node) | writes `objectName` and `dataProvider` | writes `objectName` only |
| `DashboardGridLayout`, pivot arm (`pivot` node) | writes `objectName` and `dataProvider` | writes `objectName` only |
| `ObjectPivotTableProps['schema']` (prop type of the exported `ObjectPivotTable`) | `dataProvider?: { provider: string; object?: string }` | `dataProvider?: never`, a tombstone. There is no zod face: neither `object-pivot` nor `PivotTableSchema` has a mirror. |
| `ObjectDataTableSchema`, TS interface (`@object-ui/types`) | not released (enters with objectui#6576, changeset still pending) | `dataProvider?: never`, a tombstone |
| `ObjectDataTableSchema`, zod mirror (`@object-ui/types/zod`) | not released | `dataProvider: retirementTombstone(...)`, which refuses the key by name. Its message says to write `objectName`. |

I measured the released column with `npm pack` of `@object-ui/types@17.6.0` and `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard@17.6.0` (both are `latest`), using a word-bounded grep:

- **types 17.6.0**: 0 files name `dataProvider` and 0 name `ObjectDataTableSchema`. The control, `DashboardSchema`, is found in 4 files. An unbounded grep also finds one `CHANGELOG.md` line, but that is the `MetadataProvider` substring trap.
- **plugin-dashboard 17.6.0**: `dist/ObjectDataTable.d.ts` and `dist/ObjectPivotTable.d.ts` both declare `dataProvider?`, and `dist/index.js` carries 3 `dataProvider: ` writes.

The changeset is `.changeset/7353-retire-widget-dataprovider.md`. It declares `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` minor with a BREAKING body, and `@object-ui/types` minor, per AGENTS.md §9. It is written against released 17.6.0: the published narrowing is plugin-dashboard's, and no released `@object-ui/types` validator changes verdict.

**Pre-edit re-grep (H1).** I ran a word-bounded `dataProvider` grep over every tracked file at base `660d31185`. It left out the `const dataProvider = ...provider` locals in calendar, gantt, map, tree and core's `record-source` test, which triage ruled unrelated, and the `apps/console` comment about them. It found:

- the three writes and the three declarations at the sites the dispatch named;
- one comment in `ObjectPivotTable`;
- two fixtures in `objectql-union-arms-7363.test.ts`.

It found no reader, no doc and no README that uses the key. `@objectstack/spec` declares neither `object-data-table` nor `dataProvider`.

## objectui#4357 question (H2): the key never reached a DOM attribute

A one-off probe, not committed, rendered all three producer paths for real on base `660d31185`. It listed every attribute on every element and spied on `console.error`:

| Render | Elements | `dataprovider` / `data-provider` attributes | React unknown-prop warnings naming it |
|---|---|---|---|
| renderer, table | 68 | 0 | 0 |
| grid, table | 31 | 0 | 0 |
| grid, pivot | 23 | 0 | 0 |
| positive control: a div with the same object spread onto it | 2 | 1 (`dataprovider`) | 1 |

This change does not close any objectui#4357-class leak.

## What the zod mirror does with an authored `dataProvider` (H3)

- **Bare deletion, measured at `35624634f` (round 1).** `ObjectDataTableSchema` extends the `.passthrough()` `BaseSchema`, so an authored `dataProvider` was kept on the parsed value and checked by nothing, whether well-formed or malformed. The TS face has `[key: string]: any`, so authoring the key still compiled. That was the same silent no-op the card exists to end.
- **Tombstone, at this head.** A well-formed value and a malformed value are both refused **by name**, at path `dataProvider`, with code `invalid_type`. The message names `objectName`. The refusal also reaches authors through `safeValidateSchema`. An undeclared key is still accepted and kept (control). On the TS faces, authoring `dataProvider` is a compile error on both carriers.
- **Released terms.** `@object-ui/types@17.6.0` declares neither the schema nor the key, so no released validator's verdict moves. `ObjectDataTableSchema` ships for the first time with `dataProvider` already refused.

**Why a tombstone rather than a deletion.** I used the repo's retirement discriminator: objectui#5941 and #7526, as amended by objectui#7678, stated on `KanbanColumn.color` in `packages/types/src/complex.ts`. A `?: never` tombstone is available only on a surviving carrier. On such a carrier it is used when either prong holds:

1. it steers authors to a named live replacement key;
2. docs taught the key as working.

Here:

- Both carriers survive: `ObjectDataTableSchema` and `ObjectPivotTableProps['schema']`.
- Prong 1 holds: `objectName` is the key both widgets read.
- Prong 2 does not hold: no doc, README or CHANGELOG ever taught the key.

A tombstone refuses a key and reads nothing, so the ruling's "no reader is added" still holds.

## Hand-off to the spec lane (`packages/types`)

Triage note 5548497098 and the ruling put the `packages/types` half in this PR instead of a separate card. For the `domain:spec` lane:

- `ObjectDataTableSchema` is still unreleased. Its `dataProvider` member changes from a typed optional object to a retirement tombstone, on the TS face and the zod face.
- No other member moves.
- **Union-arms fixture triage.** The "with its keys" fixture drops `dataProvider`, because the key is now refused. The rejection row that probed `dataProvider.provider` is removed, not respelled, because it pinned the retired typed declaration. The by-name refusal of the key now lives in the retirement pin below. The arm is still probed by name through `searchable`.

## Pins

**`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/widgetDataProviderRetired-7353.test.tsx`**

- It records every node handed to `SchemaRenderer` and then renders it with the real renderer. It checks:
  - the `DashboardRenderer` `object-data-table` node, and the `data-table` node that widget renders next;
  - the `DashboardGridLayout` `data-table` node and `pivot` node.
- Each node must have no `dataProvider` and must keep `objectName` (control).
- The widget must still fetch through `objectName` (control).
- Type level: `ObjectPivotTableProps['schema']['dataProvider']` and `ObjectDataTableProps['schema']['dataProvider']` must both be exactly `undefined`, which is how a `?: never` tombstone reads. `objectName` must stay `string | undefined` (control).
- `@ts-expect-error` on authoring `dataProvider` on both prop types, with an undeclared key compiling without a directive (control).
- `ObjectDataTableProps` reads `@object-ui/types` through the built `.d.ts`.

**`packages/types/src/__tests__/object-data-table-dataprovider-retired-7353.test.ts`**

- The TS face must read as `undefined` (tombstone), with `objectName` live (control).
- `@ts-expect-error` on authoring both a well-formed and a malformed value, with an undeclared key compiling (control).
- The zod face must refuse both a well-formed and a malformed value by name (path `dataProvider`, `invalid_type`, message names `objectName`), including through `safeValidateSchema`.
- An undeclared key must still be accepted and kept, and a node without `dataProvider` must validate (controls).

## Red on the earlier trees, green on the head

**Node pins on base `660d31185` (round 1).** 3 failed and 1 passed. Each failure was `expected [...] to not include 'dataProvider'`.

**Reverse verification at `511316a02`.** A trap-guarded script put the five source files back from each earlier tree and kept the pins. Each leg rebuilt `@object-ui/types` and ran the three pin files and both type-checks.

**Leg A: `35624634f` (bare deletion).** On disk there were 0 tombstones and 0 writes, and the dist had 0 tombstones.

- vitest: 3 failed, 16 passed. The failures were the zod well-formed, malformed and `safeValidateSchema` cases (`expected true to be false`).
- types type-check: exit 2. `TS2344` on the tombstone `Equal` line, plus `TS2578` unused directive on both authoring lines.
- plugin-dashboard type-check: exit 2. `TS2344` on both `Equal` lines, plus `TS2578` on both authoring lines.
- The controls and the node pins stayed green.

**Leg B: `660d31185` (original base).** On disk there were 0 tombstones and 3 writes.

- vitest: 6 failed, 13 passed. The failures were the three node pins, the zod well-formed case (accepted), the zod malformed case (refused at `dataProvider.provider` instead of at the key: `expected [] to have a length of 1`), and the `safeValidateSchema` case.
- types type-check: exit 2. `TS2344` on the `Equal` line, plus `TS2578` on the well-formed authoring line. The malformed line was already an error under the typed member, so its directive held.
- plugin-dashboard type-check: exit 2 with 4 errors, as in Leg A.
- The controls stayed green.

**Restore, after each leg and at exit.** `git checkout HEAD --` on absolute paths. All five files were hash-equal to their HEAD blobs, `git diff HEAD` was 0 bytes and `git status` was clean. `@object-ui/types` was rebuilt, and the dist tombstone hits were 1.

## Gates (at head `511316a02`)

- **Tests.** `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-dashboard/ packages/types/ packages/plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.schemaTyped-8655.test.ts packages/react/src/hooks/__tests__/navigationOverlayConsumers.onRowClickArity-9357.test.ts`: `Test Files 363 passed (363)`, `Tests 6442 passed (6442)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Type-check.** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard run type-check`: both full chains, including `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`. This ran after building the plugin-dashboard dependency closure (12 `build: Done`).
- **Changeset gates**, exit 0:
  - `check-changeset-presence`: "8 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)".
  - `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-fixed` and `check:pending-changeset-literals`.
  - `check:changeset-claims` is report-only.
- **Citation and byte gates**, exit 0: `check:new-line-citations` (`VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`) and `check:control-bytes`.
- **Mock and test-root gates**, exit 0: `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape` and `check-test-path-roots`.
- **Types-surface and doc gates**, exit 0:
  - `check:spec-symbols`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:prompt-keys`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check-type-check-coverage` and `check-lint-coverage`.
  - `check:component-surface-parity` is report-only, with `read-of-tombstoned-key 0`.
- **Lint, measured over a proven narrowing.** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 8 touched TS files gave 8 files, 0 errors and 63 warnings. The narrowing rests on three facts:
  1. `eslint --print-config` accepts all 8 files.
  2. The JSON output has 8 entries.
  3. `eslint.config.js` has no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and the diff cannot change a judgement on an untouched file.
- **NOT MEASURED locally.** `check:readme-exports`, `check:doc-examples` and `check-skill-examples` need the whole package set built. `check:sdui-registration-pins` needs a console build. The diff touches no README, doc or registration, and CI runs them.
- **CI on `511316a02`.** 43 check-runs: 40 success and 3 skipped.

## Acceptance notes

- **Clause-②.** The line stays `yes`, which the contract review confirmed.
- **Out of scope, filed by the seat as objectui#10528** (class a, reproducible with the H2 probe). `DashboardGridLayout`'s `provider: 'object'` table and pivot widgets never fetch. They become `data-table` / `pivot` nodes with `data: []`, and those renderers read no `objectName`. On the base, the probe measured `find` called 0 times and the fetched row text absent for both, while `DashboardRenderer` fetched and rendered the same widget. objectui#7353 does not address this.
